propositions: pytest-xdist worker process crashes intermittently on Python 3.11 during test_matching_guard_is_accepted, surfacing as 'worker gwN crashed' and 'node down: Not properly terminated'

CPython issue 86296 causes asyncio.wait_for to consume external cancellation when child completes in same event-loop turn, leaving worker task with cancelling()=1 and blocking indefinitely at queue.get()
Replacing asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=X) with async with asyncio.timeout(X): await asyncio.to_thread(...) restores correct cancellation semantics on Python 3.11
Defect is Python 3.11 specific; Python 3.12+ unaffected, explaining CI-only intermittent failure on py3.11 matrix leg
Fix commit 8c9bf5d78d resolves the hang; regression tests confirm worker cancellation survives job completion race
